import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler, StandardScaler, RobustScaler
from scipy.stats import skew

# Dataset with outliers and different distributions
np.random.seed(42)
data = {
    'feature_a': np.concatenate([np.random.normal(0, 1, 90), np.random.normal(10, 2, 10)]),
    'feature_b': np.random.exponential(2, 100),
    'feature_c': np.random.uniform(-5, 5, 100)
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Apply all three scaling methods
df_minmax = pd.DataFrame(MinMaxScaler().fit_transform(df), columns=df.columns)
df_standard = pd.DataFrame(StandardScaler().fit_transform(df), columns=df.columns)
df_robust = pd.DataFrame(RobustScaler().fit_transform(df), columns=df.columns)

# Compare the range, mean, and std of each scaled version
print("=== Comparison Summary ===")
for name, df_scaled in [('MinMax', df_minmax), ('Standard', df_standard), ('Robust', df_robust)]:
    print(f"\n{name} Scaler:")
    print(f"  Min: {df_scaled.min().to_dict()}")
    print(f"  Max: {df_scaled.max().to_dict()}")
    print(f"  Mean: {df_scaled.mean().round(2).to_dict()}")
    print(f"  Std: {df_scaled.std().round(2).to_dict()}")

# Print a comparison summary table
print("\n=== Feature A (with outliers) Comparison ===")
print(f"Original range: [{df['feature_a'].min():.2f}, {df['feature_a'].max():.2f}]")
print(f"MinMax range:   [{df_minmax['feature_a'].min():.2f}, {df_minmax['feature_a'].max():.2f}]")
print(f"Standard range: [{df_standard['feature_a'].min():.2f}, {df_standard['feature_a'].max():.2f}]")
print(f"Robust range:   [{df_robust['feature_a'].min():.2f}, {df_robust['feature_a'].max():.2f}]")
